levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «و ما كان فيه عن عمران الحلبي» at the start is the book's subject, not a link; the chain's last name is its second occurrence
«و كنيته أبو الفضل» is a remark on his kunya, not a link
The compiler's father is written as «أبي» without a name: relation (rule 7)
